# G.711 u-law decode golden: code (8-bit, as transmitted on the wire) -> 16-bit linear PCM
# Source: ITU-T G.191 STL g711.c ulaw_expand() (output 16-bit left-justified = 14-bit value x4,
# midpoint of the decision interval). Cross-checked identical for all 256 codes against
# Sun Microsystems g711.c, FFmpeg pcm_mulaw, SoX and CPython audioop.
